Name: HorseFollowsYou
Author: kaniclub
Description:
[b]HorseFollowsYou[/b]
HorseFollowsYou is a simple mod that makes your horse follow you around like a cute little friend.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Your horse follows you around
[*]Cross-map follow support where horse movement is allowed
[*]Optional auto-enable follow when mounting your horse or summoning it with the Horse Flute
[*]Optional follow-on-load setting
[*]Optional warp visual effects and sound when the mod warps your horse
[*]Optional GMCM setting to exclude specific horse-like mounts from follow behavior per save
[*]Config support through config.json and GMCM
[/list]

[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional)
[/list]

[b]Installation[/b]
[list]
[*]Install SMAPI
[*]Extract HorseFollowsYou into your Mods folder
[*]Launch the game
[/list]

[b]How to use[/b]
[list]
[*]Press the toggle key to turn horse follow on or off (default: H)
[*]When enabled, your horse will follow you around
[*]You can also enable automatic follow when mounting your horse or summoning it with the Horse Flute
[*]If your horse is still inside the stable, it cannot follow you out on its own, so you will need to ride it once or move it out with a warp first
[/list]

[b]Configuration[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Enable Mod[/b] - Turns the mod on or off
[*][b]Cross-Map Follow[/b] - Lets your horse follow you between maps where horse movement is allowed
[*][b]HUD Messages[/b] - Shows a short message when follow is turned on or off
[*][b]Toggle Key[/b] - Changes the key used to turn follow on or off
[*][b]Follow Start Distance[/b] - Sets how far away your horse must be before it starts following
[*][b]Stop Distance[/b] - Sets how close your horse gets before stopping
[*][b]Path Rebuild Interval[/b] - Controls how often the follow path is recalculated
[*][b]Near / Mid / Far Speed Multiplier[/b] - Adjusts horse movement speed based on distance
[*][b]Narrow Hitbox[/b] - Uses a narrower collision size for better support with 1-tile path horse mods
[*][b]Ignore Player Collision[/b] - Prevents only the currently active followed horse from colliding with the player
[*][b]Enable Follow on Mount / Flute[/b] - Automatically enables follow when you mount your horse or summon it with the Horse Flute
[*][b]Enable Follow On Load[/b] - Controls whether follow starts enabled when a save is loaded
[*][b]Warp Effects and Sound[/b] - Toggles warp visual effects and sound when this mod warps your horse
[*][b]Pathfinding Abort Distance[/b] - Sets the distance where follow handling switches to the selected fallback behavior
[*][b]Action on Abort / No Path[/b] - Chooses what happens when pathfinding fails or is aborted: Wait, Warp Nearby, Turn Follow Off, or Do Not Move
[*][b]Excluded Horse-Like Mounts[/b] - Lets you exclude specific horse-like mounts from follow behavior per save
[/list]
